done_when: A story's plan read stops after two rounds that have no blocking notes on new text, and an edit only below For the builders never asks for another read

findings.body: The upgrade test creates every read note after upgrading, so it cannot catch a regression in how round three handles changed Answers for stories already being read on an earlier release. Raise: Test. The test calls `_client` before `new_story` and the first `forge read` (lines 57–69), while earlier-release notes have no `answers_seen` field (`tests/fixtures/forge-v1.2.2/src/forge/story.py:249`). Removing the new fallback for that missing field would leave all nine named tests passing, yet an upgraded story could miss a blocking conflict in changed Answers text.
findings.title: Not done: test the changed Answers rule with pre-upgrade read notes

stop.reason: Coordinator decision under the owner's low-risk rule (risk 2): from round three, a change to the linked spec or the brief's Answers since the last round also counts as changed text that can block

why: Plan reads loop for many rounds (21 on one story), each round an exchange with the owner
